title: create_vacancy ids are deterministic yet appended without uniqueness check — comment claims the opposite
evidence:
+/// Stable short id suffix from a property name (lowercase alphanumeric,
+/// up to 8 chars) so re-created demo vacancies don't collide.
...
+  let suffix = id_suffix(payload.property_name)
+  let id = "v-demo-" <> suffix
...
+      vacancies: list.append(store.vacancies, [
+        DemoVacancy(vacancy: vac, applications: [], archived_at: None),
+      ]),
detail: Suffix derives solely from the property name, so creating two vacancies sharing an 8-char prefix yields identical ids and short_codes ("RTDEMO"<>suffix), appended blindly. find_vacancy/list.find always resolves the first; the second row is unreachable.
recommended_fix: Derive the suffix from name plus a per-store counter or existing-id check, or reject/normalize duplicates before appending.

title: Reminder mutations are no-ops while awaiting/remindable reads are static, contradicting the store's own derived-state invariant
detail: send_reminder/remind_applicant return the store unchanged and never set reminded, while awaiting and remindable_count_for read a static list. After "Send reminder to N", the count and rows never change — the documented re-derivation contract is broken.
recommended_fix: Move the awaiting rows into DemoVacancy (or key them by vacancy in the store) and have the reminder mutations set reminded/followup flags, so refetches re-derive.

title: RefcheckEditCorrect save discards the landlord's typed corrections; only substitute honors them
evidence:
+            RefcheckEditCorrect -> fire_demo_refcheck(model, call_id, "correct")
...
+    "correct" ->
+      ReferenceCallDetail(..call, correction_cycles: call.correction_cycles + 1)
...
+/// Substitute action with the typed referee trio — discarding the landlord's
+/// just-typed contacts would silently lose their input.
detail: The correct path drops edit.name/email/phone entirely — apply_refcheck only bumps correction_cycles. The substitute path was explicitly fixed to preserve typed contacts; corrections typed into the same §8.3 trio silently vanish.
recommended_fix: Route corrections through refcheck_action_with_contact and have apply_refcheck's "correct" case overwrite the non-empty typed fields like substitute does.

title: fetch_leaderboard_page ignores the _page argument — load-more can never return different data
evidence:
+pub fn fetch_leaderboard_page(
+  store: DemoStore,
+  vacancy_id: String,
+  _page: Int,
+  on_response: fn(Result(LeaderboardResponse, ApiError)) -> msg,
+) -> Effect(msg) {
+  case demo_store.leaderboard(store, vacancy_id) {
detail: Caller passes model.leaderboard_page + 1, but the page is discarded and the full list is always returned. Depending on ApiReturnedLeaderboardPage's append/replace semantics, load-more either no-ops or duplicates rows.
recommended_fix: Slice the derived entries by page/window inside fetch_leaderboard_page, or document that the demo leaderboard is single-page and hide load-more.

title: update_vacancy drops "draft" to old.status while create_vacancy honors it
evidence:
+              status: case payload.status {
+                "active" -> Active
+                "closed" -> Closed
+                _ -> old.status
+              },
...
+      status: case payload.status {
+        "active" -> Active
+        "draft" -> Draft
+        _ -> Draft
+      },
detail: Create maps payload.status "draft" to Draft, but update's catch-all keeps the previous status — a draft-status update payload silently leaves the vacancy Active/Closed while reporting success.
recommended_fix: Add a "draft" -> Draft arm to update_vacancy's status mapping (or assert the payload can never carry it).

title: Single notification read leaves unread_count untouched while mark-all clears it (the exact issue W11 fixed)
evidence:
+      // The real arm closes the dropdown after marking read — mirror it.
+      #(
+        Model(
+          ..model,
+          demo_store: Some(next),
+          show_notification_dropdown: False,
+        ),
+        eff,
+      )
...
+      // W11 (r4): clear the badge optimistically like the real arm — the
+      // store mutation alone leaves the bell's unread count stale.
+      #(Model(..model, demo_store: Some(next), unread_count: 0), eff)
detail: Mark-all optimistically zeroes model.unread_count; the single-read arm only mutates the store. Unless ApiReturnedMarkRead recomputes it, the bell badge stays stale after reading one notification.
recommended_fix: Decrement unread_count (floored at 0) for the read notification, mirroring the W11 treatment.

title: demo_api reminder/bulk-invite mirrors discard the returned store while every other mutation persists it
evidence:
+  let #(next, result) = demo_store.send_reminder(store, vacancy_id)
+  let _ = next
+  deliver(on_response, result)
...
+pub fn create_vacancy(
...
+) -> #(DemoStore, Effect(msg)) {
+  let #(next, vacancy) = demo_store.create_vacancy(store, payload)
+  #(next, deliver(on_response, vacancy))
detail: These three return plain Effect and throw away `next` via `let _ = next`; all other mutations return #(DemoStore, Effect) for the caller to stash. Harmless today only because the store fns return the input unchanged — any future store change is silently lost.
recommended_fix: Return #(DemoStore, Effect(msg)) from these mirrors too (or drop the store from their demo_store signatures if they genuinely never mutate).
